Requirement: Breeding Stock source must create a sellable breeding-stock pool listing
Finding: Breeding Stock candidates are shown but cannot be attached or sold because the attach and availability paths still hard-code Standard Stock only.
Evidence: StorefrontPigPoolService::candidatesForCategory maps breeding to stock_type=breeding, but attachPigs rejects any pig whose stock_type is not standard and availableCount excludes non-standard stock.
Reproduction: Post a Breeding Stock push request with a breeding pig. The listing row is created, then pig attach fails and no pool availability exists.
User Impact: Staff see a breeding listing shell but cannot actually sell breeding stock through the storefront.
Stock Impact: Breeding stock never becomes available in the listing pool and cannot synchronize through approval/direct sale lifecycle.
Financial Impact: No canonical PigSale can be created from the intended breeding pool path.
Security Impact: Low direct security impact, but forged/normal stock category behavior diverges.
Root Cause: Partial implementation updated selector but left pool attach/availability rules standard-only.
Required Correction: Make attachPigs and availableCount validate against the listing/source category: breeding listings accept breeding stock, standard listings accept standard stock, and forged IDs are rejected. Add tests asserting pool rows and availability, not only listing kind.
Tests: php artisan test tests/Feature/Storefront/StorefrontPushCategoryTest.php passed 23 tests, showing current tests do not catch this

Requirement: Live/carcass approval must create canonical PigSales with correct weight type, kg allocation and per-kg economics
Finding: Pooled approval ignores the new order-line snapshot fields when building PigSale payloads. Live/carcass PigSales can be written with null/wrong sale_weight, null/wrong price_per_kg, and carcass can fall back to live weight_type.
Evidence: Checkout copies purchase snapshots into line_weight_kg/requested_kg/price_per_kg_snapshot, but saleDataFor reads only weight_kg and item->price_basis. For stock-backed listings, order item price_basis comes from the listing's legacy fixed basis; cart price_basis is not carried into order item price_basis.
Reproduction: Create a live or carcass cart/order from a pig pool, approve allocations, then inspect pig_sales.sale_weight, price_per_kg, and weight_type.
User Impact: /sales cannot be trusted to reflect the customer-selected animal weight or carcass kg request.
Stock Impact: Animals may be removed correctly, but sale measurement truth is wrong or absent.
Financial Impact: Finance receives PigSaleRecorded events with zero/null or wrong sale weight/rate/type, breaking live/carcass reconciliation and reports.
Security Impact: No direct authorization issue, but commercial data integrity is broken.
Root Cause: The implementation added line_weight_kg/requested_kg snapshots but the canonical sale payload still uses the legacy order_item.weight_kg/price_basis fields.
Required Correction: For live: use selected_pig_weight_snapshot or line_weight_kg per live line and price_per_kg_snapshot. For carcass: allocate requested_kg deterministically across selected pigs so sum(PigSale.sale_weight)=requested_kg and weight_type=carcass; ensure sum prices equals line_total. Copy/derive order-item price basis from purchase_type where appropriate. Add failing tests for PigSale sale_weight/weight_type/price_per_kg sums.
Tests: Existing grep found no allocation-service use of line_weight_kg; focused push category test passed but unrelated

Requirement: Manual Entry sales must reach Finance without fake PigSale
Finding: Manual Entry/non-pig listings can complete the storefront commercial flow but the finance subscriber intentionally marks unsupported manual kinds as skipped/deferred instead of posting revenue through a canonical non-pig path.
Evidence: routeLine only auto-routes live_pig/breeding_stock and feed; manure/service/piglet/manual kinds return kind_not_auto_postable. routeFeedLine requires FeedType source_id, which a generic manual entry does not have. Existing test asserts manure is skipped.
Reproduction: Create Manual Entry manure/service or manual feed with no FeedType source, order and confirm, then run StorefrontOrderConfirmedSubscriber. finance_posting_status becomes skipped/deferred and no sale/finance record exists.
User Impact: Manual storefront sales become a dead end for staff and customer settlement.
Stock Impact: No pig stock should move, but non-pig inventory/commercial state is not represented.
Financial Impact: Revenue, AR/cash, invoice/reporting can be absent for manual sale lines.
Root Cause: The subscriber preserved only pre-existing pig/feed source-based sale routing; the new Manual Entry category lacks a canonical commercial posting path.
Required Correction: Implement a canonical manual/non-pig Storefront sale/finance path or restrict Manual Entry to supported source-backed kinds. Tests must prove no fake PigSale and a real finance transaction/reporting record.
Tests: Source audit only; existing test documents current skipped behavior

Requirement: Push page category must drive server behavior and removed generic fields must not be forgeable
Finding: Hidden/removed technical fields are not truly server-derived. A forged request can provide kind, sale_mode, pricing_basis, and currency_code because prepareForValidation keeps submitted values if present.
Evidence: prepareForValidation uses input('kind') ?: derived, input('sale_mode') ?: fixed, input('pricing_basis') ?: fixed, input('currency_code') ?: GHS. categoryKindMatches only checks optional storefront category_id kind, not source_category-kind mapping.
Reproduction: Submit source_category=standard_stock with kind=feed or pricing_basis=carcass/quote/hidden through direct POST.
User Impact: Staff UI is cleaner, but direct requests can create contradictory listings and downstream dead ends.
Stock Impact: Pool rows may be attached to a listing kind that is not the intended stock source.
Financial Impact: Can misroute finance or pricing behavior by changing hidden technical columns.
Security Impact: Client-side tampering can alter canonical server behavior.
Root Cause: Normalization is fallback-based instead of authoritative derivation.
Required Correction: For non-manual categories overwrite kind, sale_mode, pricing_basis, currency_code, quantity, weight and price fields from trusted server calculation. Validate manual separately. Add tampering tests.
Tests: Not executed as a forged test; source proof is sufficient
Notes: Material P1 also blocks smoke-test readiness.

Requirement: Stock-backed listings must not create empty dead-end listings without selected stock
Finding: A non-manual stock-backed push request with no pool_pig_ids can create an empty listing shell instead of rejecting before save.
Evidence: prepareForValidation sets quantity_available to 0 when no selected pigs exist; controller only calls attachPigs when poolPigIds is non-empty, so attachPigs' empty-selection exception is bypassed.
Reproduction: Post source_category=standard_stock or breeding_stock with title and no pool_pig_ids.
User Impact: Staff can create empty stock-backed listing shells that cannot be bought or fulfilled without extra cleanup.
Stock Impact: No stock is linked; availability and snapshots are absent or zero.
Financial Impact: No direct finance effect until sold, but the workflow is a dead end.
Root Cause: The empty-selection guard lives in attachPigs but the controller skips attachPigs when the submitted list is empty.
Required Correction: Reject empty pool_pig_ids for standard/breeding categories in PushToStorefrontRequest before listing creation. For piglets/manual, keep separate rules.
Tests: Not executed; source proof is sufficient

Requirement: Stock selector search must include all required search dimensions
Finding: Search does not cover every required dimension. SQL search covers ear tag/code/local_id/breed/gender; rendered client search covers ear tag/breed/gender only. Age and latest weight are not searchable.
Evidence: eligiblePigsForListing search closure omits age/weight; push blade data-pig-search omits local ID/code/age/weight.
Reproduction: Try searching by latest weight or age in the selector.
User Impact: Lower convenience for staff on large herds.
Root Cause: Search implementation is narrower than the stated requirement.
Required Correction: Extend server/client search tokens to include local ID/code/age/latest weight, with tests for each.
Notes: Non-blocking by itself, but should be fixed.
